scope: Every row is independently paired to its same-protocol locked baseline over all five strict scenes. Counts classify unordered pairs of common, one-to-one IoU≥0.5 GT-matched detector outputs; pairs never cross scenes. Long tracks contribute quadratically. These are output relations, not numbers of Hungarian decisions. Added/removed and unmatched detections are separately excluded from correctness counts. GT enters only post-run analysis.
limitations: Offline GMT includes its original full-video postprocessing; causal GMT uses the separate streaming baseline. Values across those protocols are not paired comparisons. Missing complete suites remain pending. Actual pre-bank Hungarian decision recording is a separate scene1 diagnostic.
